scenario: Duration literal is one token with a positive integer followed directly by a time unit suffix per LGRA.2.8.2. Pin: `30_s`, `5_min`, `2_h`, `1_d` all parse cleanly as duration literals in the `within` clause.
rules_ds:
schema Ev scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    ts: Time

rule r:
    Ev
    then Ev within 1_d
->
    log info "ok"
